$comment: Critical surface for the blast-radius override. Copy to .quality-kernel/critical-surface.json in your project and adjust the globs. Any change whose diff touches these paths forces tier T1+ and requires the blind breaker (live oracle) to pass before merge, regardless of change size. If this file is absent, /forge treats any change outside docs/tests/styling/tooling as critical (fail-safe).
$safeGlobsNote: Test files are deliberately NOT safe: editing a test moves coverage, so route floors any test change at 'standard' (and a test DELETION is always critical). Keep only truly inert paths here.
